releaseIntent: Deliver one production-grade, openly reviewable v2.0 candidate under the canonical YIYUAN Accord identity, with fresh behavior evidence and no compatibility alias for the superseded identity.

increment.observedProblem: The public repository display was renamed while the active module, package identifiers, commands, authority files, documentation and observations still carried a superseded technical identity. Staging aliases would preserve ambiguity, and relabeling v1.2 observations would manufacture evidence for a projection they never exercised. The accepted reports also require a clearer product category, explicit human-AI mission versus current human-Agent scope, tighter lifecycle evaluation and a finite path to closeout.
increment.hypothesis: One complete breaking identity migration, a single collaboration reliability domain model, thin runtime-free projections, a generic verifier and fresh current-projection Golden Task observations can restore global consistency without adding a compatibility layer or turning the framework into a runtime, governance platform or universal correctness claim.

historical observations are edited or relabeled as current v2.0 evidence

increment.finiteStopCondition: Stop this increment when one locally committed clean candidate has the canonical v2.0 identity and domain model aligned across the active tree, the live verifier computes every deterministic lane, every required current-projection Golden Task has substantive fresh evidence without hidden failure, all eight repository criteria are satisfied and no known validation defect or task residue remains. Exact local verification and independent review, push, hosted verification, named-human authorization, publication and post-release cleanup follow only through the ordered task-time gates.

closeoutSequence.stopCondition: [canonical-identity-authority-and-projections] Every stage-zero regular file declared by the Git index uses the canonical v2.0 identity inside the exact lexical non-Python path and whole-text boundary or shared-grammar Python identifier/literal boundary; indeterminate surfaces fail closed, digest-bound Markdown research inputs under research/reviews remain inert, incompatible old observations are not current evidence and no compatibility alias is declared.

[static-conformance-and-adversarial-regressions] The generic verifier computes deterministic conformance directly; complete projection-package checks, release-surface bindings, full regression tests and residue checks pass without a known validation defect. No repository observation may self-attest these results.

[fresh-representative-behavior] Each required Golden Task has one fresh current-projection observation with independent source evidence, predeclared behavior decisions, human-burden metrics, material effects, cleanup disposition and an explicit claim limit; designated authority, evidence, no-op and subtraction guardrails pass, while any admissible failure remains failed and its exact exclusions are aggregated into the public claim ceiling.

[repository-candidate-freeze] All eight repository criteria are satisfied on one clean tree, the release body is time-neutral and reproducible, no known blocker or task residue remains, the increment and work item are retained as completed, and the exact candidate is committed locally for the task-time verification-and-review gate.

orderedGates.condition: One locally committed clean candidate aligns the canonical identity, domain model, authority, verifier, reference projections, documentation, tests and fresh representative evidence; all eight repository criteria are satisfied and no known blocker or task residue remains.

On the unchanged clean local candidate, the active goal carrier directly runs the canonical verifier, both host checks, full product tests, diff, identity, link, workflow and residue checks plus independent specification, implementation-robustness and standards-conformance review. An independent human or second observation surface compares the publishable source bundle with the original host or session records, and one evaluator isolated from candidate-preparation context completes a clean-state README activation, confirmation and removal walkthrough. The sample is context-isolated, outcome-bound, identity-neutral and internal only; the accountable user, a colleague or a second observation surface may execute it. Any P0/P1 blocks the gate. Repository self-report cannot satisfy it, and only after it passes may the same SHA be pushed.

After push, the active goal carrier directly verifies the unchanged clean HEAD on GitHub Actions for Linux, Windows and macOS plus ordinary Codex Cloud; repository self-report and earlier revisions are insufficient.

Only after exact hosted verification, present the unchanged SHA, complete claim ceiling, retained failures and continuing evidence lanes to a named accountable human; the decision must preserve a real veto and is not written into the candidate.
Create the lightweight v2.0 tag and public release only after hosted verification and exact named-human authorization for the unchanged candidate; do not move the tag or attach assets.

The active goal carrier directly verifies the public release, remote and local tag, exact tracked release notes and zero-asset policy; it then removes task-created resources, confirms repository and evaluator residue are absent, and replays local validation.

releaseProcedure.rule: Execute gates strictly in listed order. A failure, material correction, later rule or revision returns to the earliest affected dependency boundary; affected current-candidate evidence and every downstream gate remain superseded until replayed. No report, plan, test, commit, push, hosted pass or authorization is promoted into a later effect.

goalModePrompt.objective: 在 product/constitution.json、product/program.json、product/acceptance.json 三份唯一语义权威下，以少数稳定常量驱动动态执行：用户当前目标与纠正优先，事实以可复验直接证据为准，后果性判断和发布权属于人类，优先最小充分路线，任何补充、失败、误判或修订都从最早受影响依赖边界撤销旧证明并重放全部下游门，同时保留无关已验事实。完成 YIYUAN Accord v2.0 的有限工业/商业级交付；保持开放、Agent 中立和无 Runtime/Hook/MCP/App，广义使命面向人类与 AI 协作，当前证明仅限声明的人类与 Agent 协作契约、参考投影和代表性样本，不推广为通用正确性、跨宿主或生产效果。现场证据决定首个未完成阶段，严格按 canonical-identity-authority-and-projections → static-conformance-and-adversarial-regressions → fresh-representative-behavior → repository-candidate-freeze 推进；每阶段以 R1-R4/Q1-Q4、停止条件和副作用边界验收，不让计划或旧 Goal 反向覆盖新证据。七项当前样本必须同时绑定任务、投影身份和结构化 projectionExposure；GT-01/02 采用 Claude Code --bare 的可复验运行时 Skill 归因与宿主外检查，GT-03/04/05/08 采用独立核对的精确 Codex Skill 内容，旧 Codex 归因只保留为失效历史；GT-07 连续性通过但任务时清理失败，retainedBehaviorExclusions 保持为 ["GT-07:cleanup"]，后续夹具清理不得改写行为结论。路由或模型标签只作为该次宿主观察，不作为普遍模型身份；配置、历史和安全软件属于可控宿主变量，环境中断与项目行为失败分开判定。涉及 Codex 宿主事实时优先核对当前官方一手资料，禁止账户门控的专用审查能力，不把官方实现复制进便携核心。候选严格依次经过 repository-candidate → exact-local-verification-and-review → exact-candidate-hosted-verification → exact-human-release-authorization → exact-tagged-public-release → release-verification-and-cleanup。推送前必须在同一 clean SHA 串行完成 canonical verifier、两个 host-check、全量 product tests、actionlint/diff/identity/link/workflow/residue 检查，独立规格、实现稳健性与标准符合性反审，可发布 source bundle 与原始宿主记录的独立对照，以及由与候选制作上下文隔离的评估者（可为用户、同事或第二观察面）从 clean state 完成 README 启用、确认、移除走查；效力取决于测试条件与结果，不取决于作者身份。之后才可推送并核验 GitHub 三系统与普通 Codex Cloud，再请求该 SHA 的新具名人类授权，创建轻量 v2.0 tag 和无资产 release，最后复验公开面、清理任务资源并重放本地验证。报告、计划、测试、提交、推送、托管绿灯或授权都不是收官；仅在人类判断、账户、外部信任、发布或不可逆边界暂停。

complexityBudget.rule: Every retained mechanism must pay rent in observed help, risk reduction or recovery value after code, prompt, evidence, topology, cognition and lifecycle cost. The former 134000-byte target remains a recorded failed target: reproduced Python-depth, suffix, shell, PowerShell, CMD, pipeline and descriptor-provenance counterexamples invalidated its simpler scanning premise. An intermediate 210000-byte multi-host lexical path was not accepted: repeated same-purpose option, encoding, execution-input and provenance findings plus its headroom breach triggered the required premise, interface and deletion review while Q3 remained blocked. The first reduced 150000-byte replacement and its 141151-byte measurement were then invalidated by reproduced deep literal-concatenation and marker-only workflow cases plus Git-index provenance, truly bounded owned-file I/O and exact-token-boundary regressions. The second deletion review removed the version-specific f/t-string parser, non-Python escape interpretation and fragment propagation. The retained mechanism now uses the Git index as its finite declaration source, one shared Python 3.10 AST grammar with linear bounded static-subtree summaries across supported Python 3.10-3.14 hosts, strict non-Python decoding with exact NFKC/casefold lexical boundaries, descriptor-bound pre/post-stable regular-file reads, and file-backed Git metadata/history capture with time and size limits; it fails closed on indeterminate declared surfaces and exempts only digest-bound Markdown research inputs under research/reviews. It proves only this static declared-surface boundary, not ignored or untracked files, Python comments, runtime-built or external dynamic content. The exact comment-normalized workflow profile and structured source-evidence constraints remain separate narrow release controls. The 164000-byte ceiling left only 302 bytes beyond its five-percent reserve on the prior clean candidate. Confirmed official-URL normalization, malformed-enum fail-closed and externally bound post-session evidence findings triggered another deletion review; the first implementation measured 164640 bytes and was consolidated to a 160509-byte checkpoint without dropping the public-seam regressions. Later review proved that binding only magic event kinds still allowed the whole claimed event to disappear. The next premise/interface/deletion review removed unproved remote and branch-count fields and reused one public-verifier adversarial matrix. It retained the task plus mirrored-payload contract because dropping either reopens that omission, and retained the subset digest as a direct public-review seam for the exact selected bindings while the outer source-record digest continues to provide overall integrity; exact cardinality and locator uniqueness reject partial or duplicate substitutions. Its stable 163895-byte measurement breached the 170000 ceiling's reserve, so the reviewed target is 174000 bytes: 10105 bytes of headroom against a separately required 8700-byte reserve, still far below the rejected 210000-byte path. This is an evidence-triggered recalibration after deletion review, not automatic target growth; no prose snapshot substitutes for the verifier's current measurement. Any future breach again blocks Q3 and triggers premise, interface and deletion review; the scanner or binding mechanism is simplified or retired when its residual value is no longer demonstrated.

processLossControl.carrierRule: Use current source-bound host signals when reliable; if capacity is unavailable, record unknown and transition conservatively. No universal turn count, context size, token percentage or summary ratio is product authority.
processLossControl.correctionRule: A material correction, failure, later rule or revision supersedes affected current-candidate evidence from the earliest dependency boundary and requires that boundary and every downstream gate to be replayed while unrelated accepted truth remains stable. A repeated correction or failed same-purpose mechanism pauses further addition until the premise, interface and deletion option are reconsidered.
processLossControl.continuingCalibration: Post-release failures may update Golden Tasks, narrow a claim, simplify or retire a projection, or open one new bounded increment; release status does not freeze learning.
